inputs.locator: Decision feature: strict NR7 means the latest complete UTC day's normalized true range is strictly smaller than each of the preceding six complete days. NR5 and NR10 are rejection-only neighbors. Only the first complete H1 close on the immediately following UTC day strictly above the setup-day high may queue entry at the next H1 open.

Frozen policy and accounting: invest full capital in unlevered BTC or zero-yield cash, hold exactly 168 hours, deny same-open reentry and ignore overlapping signals. The exact unconditioned prior-complete-day-high breakout with the same entry and holding policy is the parent; full-capital buy-and-hold is the opportunity comparator. Design is 2020-2022, Validation is 2023-2024 and annual fair-reset folds are 2020-2024. Normal costs are 10 bps fee plus 5 bps adverse slippage per side; stress costs are 20 plus 10 bps.

Frozen all-pass gates require positive parent and candidate economics, sufficient setup and completed-trade support, at least 60 percent parent return, drawdown at most 75 percent of parent and 65 percent of buy-and-hold, Calmar at least parent and 75 percent of buy-and-hold, at least 20 percent buy-and-hold upside, stable NR5 and NR10 Validation neighbors, annual breadth, top-year and top-trade contribution at most 60 percent, P90 and terminal holding at most 168 hours and terminal liquidation cost at most 1pp. Any failure closes the family without tuning.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen BTC daily NR7 volatility-contraction-conditioned breakout on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare strict NR7 with rejection-only NR5 and NR10 against the identical unconditioned prior-day-high breakout and full-capital buy-and-hold under identical normal and stress costs. Freeze a historical candidate only if every Design, Validation, annual breadth, concentration, holding, terminal and neighbor gate passes; otherwise permanently close the exact family without tuning. This is historical development evidence, not OOS or Trading authorization.
stop_conditions: Before outcome access, validate exact task, dispatch, intent and strategy path; rehash all non-null inputs and require clean HEAD equal to origin after the package commit. Any failure is BTC_DAILY_NR7_VOLATILITY_CONTRACTION_BREAKOUT_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT.
Require the sealed H1 corpus SHA-256 e436a5a2b093365886464dd3e471cc5cd55c54bd2c06ceaa898ac218c45436dd with 52608 contiguous finite rows and 2192 complete UTC days. Do not repair a failure.

Use only strict normalized-true-range NR7 primary and strict NR5 and NR10 rejection-only neighbors, immediately-next-day prior-high close breakout, next-H1-open execution, fixed 168-hour hold and frozen costs, windows and gates.
Run the frozen runner twice to new create-only outputs and require byte-identical SHA-256 results.
Return the positive disposition only if every frozen gate passes; otherwise valid economics returns BTC_DAILY_NR7_VOLATILITY_CONTRACTION_BREAKOUT_FAMILY_CLOSE without tuning.
A positive result remains historical and REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED. It authorizes at most one independent sealed OOS and no Trading action.
